{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOUDROfM8AAAABejSwcA", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlR_zzhIEXF0", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlR_z", "number": 330, "title": "Show Download or Retry only when needed; hide download action for Ready models", "body": "## Goal

Make the Models page's per-model download action **state-dependent**, rather than showing the ambiguous **Download / retry** button in every state, including when the model is already **Ready**.

Users who deliberately want to re-download a Ready model can use **Delete cached assets**, then **Download**. Do not introduce a separate Force re-download / Refresh button.

## Current implementation

[`extension/model-cache.js`](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/extension/model-cache.js) currently constructs `this.prepare = button('Download / retry', () => this.run('prepare'))` in `ModelCard`, always keeps it visible, and renders the cache state separately. The underlying `ModelAssetCache.prepare()` verifies/reuses already cached files rather than necessarily downloading them again, so showing **Download / retry** on a Ready card is misleading.

## Required UI behavior

| Actual model/cache state | Download action |
| --- | --- |
| **Not downloaded** (including missing/partially cached assets) | Show **Download** |
| **Downloading / preparing assets** | Hide Download/Retry; show **Cancel download** while a cancellable download is active; retain progress |
| **Error** (download/integrity failure where retry is supported) | Show **Retry** |
| **Ready · Cached and verified** | **Hide Download/Retry entirely**; leave **Delete cached assets** available |
| **Checking/initial inspection** | No premature Download/Retry action until verified state is known |

1. Replace the fixed **Download / retry** label with **Download** or **Retry** based on state and show/hide it appropriately.
2. If cache inspection establishes **Ready**, do not render an active or disabled Download/Retry button; completely hide it. Keep readiness text, files/size details, license information, and **Delete cached assets**.
3. Following explicit **Delete cached assets**, re-inspect the cache; when no verified files remain, show **Not downloaded** and **Download** again, allowing a deliberate delete → re-download cycle. Avoid stale Ready states or a momentary misleading Download button during asynchronous checks.
4. Keep per-model cancel/progress/error semantics and existing `ModelAssetCache` verification, partial download resume/retry, and shared cache coordination. Error states must offer an actual recoverable Retry action; do not mask errors or prevent retry through a visibility race.
5. Respect voice/variant-dependent manifests and cross-page changes: the shown action should reflect the *currently selected model/voice cache*, including after voice changes, return to the tab, and downloads/deletions made in other pages. Do not accidentally delete or re-download unrelated shared assets.
6. Keep graph Auto Save and Live automatic model preparation working as before. The change is **only the Models page control presentation**; deliberate manual deletion could be followed by another consumer preparing the same asset, and this existing shared-cache behavior must remain safe.
7. Coordinate with [#329](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/issues/329), which removes **Check cache**; do not reintroduce it or make it necessary for button visibility.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A Ready model card displays **no Download / retry, Download, or Retry button**; **Delete cached assets** remains available.
- [ ] A never-downloaded or incomplete model displays a **Download** action.
- [ ] A failed download (or other recoverable asset error) displays **Retry** and a clear error.
- [ ] During an active download, a visible progress indicator and **Cancel download** replace the Download/Retry action.
- [ ] After deleting cached model assets, the status updates and the **Download** action reappears, so users can intentionally re-download.
- [ ] Initial checks, focus, selected voice changes and cross-tab cache updates never leave the wrong action visible or allow duplicate in-progress downloads.
- [ ] No change to integrity verification, asset caching, model inference, Auto Save preparation, or Live automatic download.
- [ ] UI and browser tests cover Ready, Not downloaded, partially cached, Downloading, Error/Retry, delete→download, voice variants, and cross-page updates.

## Touchpoints

- `extension/model-cache.js`: ModelCard button construction/state, `render(view)`, `buttons()`, `inspect()`, `run()`, and cache update handling.
- Model page UI tests and documentation that mention the old fixed **Download / retry** label.
- Existing `extension/model-asset-cache.js` download/cache API should not need behavior changes solely for this UI task.

## Related

- [#323](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/issues/323): unified downloadable lifecycle for all models.
- [#327](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/issues/327): Live automatically downloads missing models, independently of this card action.
- [#329](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/issues/329): remove redundant manual **Check cache**.
